season_title: The Unannounced Guests & Fort Kochi Days (വിരുന്നുകാരും പുതിയ തുടക്കവും)
current_arc: Season 2: Reenu's Parents in Kochi & The Fort Kochi Cafe

Sachin.attire: Olive-green linen button-down shirt over white t-shirt, dark charcoal denim jeans

Reenu.attire: Pastel mustard-yellow floral kurti over white cotton palazzo pants

Amal.attire: Solid maroon polo t-shirt with dark navy denim jeans

Madhavan.attire: White Kerala cotton jubba over gold-bordered mundu

Girija.attire: Traditional Kerala cotton cream and green saree

Reenu's Father.voice: Deep, authoritative, stern middle-aged male voice.
Reenu's Father.attire: White cotton mundu, light-blue formal shirt.
Reenu's Father.visual_dna: Stylized 3D Pixar-style cartoon character, tall, stern expression, grey-streaked short black hair, thick cartoonish mustache, wearing a traditional white cotton mundu and a crisp light-blue formal shirt.

history.synopsis: Reenu's traditional parents arrive in Kochi without warning, throwing Sachin and Reenu into sudden panic as they scramble to keep their apartment presentable.
history.cliffhanger: Just as Sachin finishes hiding a giant pile of dirty clothes, the doorbell rings, and he opens the door face-to-face with Reenu's stern father.

history.synopsis: Sachin nervously serves traditional Kerala tea to Reenu's parents while Amal desperately tries to coach Sachin via subtle hand gestures from the balcony.
history.cliffhanger: Madhavan suddenly asks Sachin what his long-term career stability looks like after quitting his London job.

history.synopsis: Sachin heads to his first official day at the InfoPark Kakkanad software office, facing a high-pressure corporate environment while Reenu cheers him on.
history.cliffhanger: Sachin receives an urgent project deadline that directly conflicts with an important family dinner with Reenu's parents.

history.synopsis: Over late-night roadside parotta, Sachin, Reenu, and Amal stumble upon a charming abandoned heritage building near Fort Kochi beach and dream of turning it into a book-cafe.
history.cliffhanger: The elderly Portuguese landlord mentions another buyer is ready to make a deposit by tomorrow morning.

history.synopsis: Amal pools together his quirky savings while Sachin and Reenu present an emotional pitch to the cafe owner, winning his heart with their creative vision.
history.cliffhanger: They sign the lease, but realize the plumbing and interiors need massive renovation within two weeks.

history.synopsis: Sachin and Reenu spend late evenings renovating the cafe, sharing playful paint fights and quiet romantic glances amidst the sawdust and warm hanging lamps.
history.cliffhanger: Reenu's mother Girija secretly spots them together through the cafe window, noticing their undeniable bond.

history.synopsis: Girija sits down with Reenu for a heart-to-heart conversation by the Marine Drive walkway, realizing how happy Sachin makes her daughter.
history.cliffhanger: Girija warns Reenu: 'Your father won't be as easy to convince, Reenu. You need to show him Sachin's true dedication.'

history.synopsis: Amal hosts a mock tasting dinner for the cafe menu with Reenu's family, resulting in hilarious culinary mishaps with extra spicy chicken cutlets and dessert disasters.
history.cliffhanger: Despite the chaos, Madhavan takes a bite of Sachin's homemade dessert and pauses in deep silence.

history.synopsis: Madhavan invites Sachin for an early morning stroll by the Fort Kochi Chinese fishing nets, asking the difficult questions about their future and family responsibilities.
history.cliffhanger: Sachin honestly confesses his fears and wholehearted love for Reenu, standing tall without dodging any question.

history.synopsis: SEASON 2 CLIMAX: The Fort Kochi book-cafe officially opens to glowing fairy lights and cheering friends. Madhavan and Girija arrive, giving their proud, heartfelt blessing to Sachin and Reenu.
history.cliffhanger: Sachin holds Reenu's hand under the glowing cafe lights, whispering: 'This is only the beginning.' Season 2 Grand Climax completed!

history.title: വിരുന്നുകാർ (The Unannounced Guests)
history.summary: Sachin and Reenu settle into their new life in Kochi. The peace is short-lived when Reenu's parents decide to pay a surprise visit, sending Sachin into a panicked cleaning frenzy.
history.cliffhanger: Sachin opens the front door to find Reenu's stern father standing right in front of him.
